g.text: Vault-backed byte accounting: staged located funding, exact settlement, deterministic replay
authenticate each purse and located authority
A later authorized credit changes only unreserved balance.
charge 1 execution unit + all payload/trace bytes;
The top-up is a separate conserving state transition.
It cannot enlarge the running reservation.
debit each purse's realized authority + bytes
transfer gateway fee to its recipient
recompute sponsors, canonical sizes, located allocation,
